data.description:
## Context / Problem
Discovered while triaging breezy-hogged-mastiff, which owns `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/unclassified.args`. These 11 entries move to `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/crlf.args`, which this bug owns.

The runner's system gitconfig sets `core.autocrlf=true` (diagnostic run 44672240702, step "Show git config": `file:C:/Program Files/Git/etc/gitconfig core.autocrlf=true`). Vendored files not pinned `eol=lf` check out with CRLF, so their pinned SHA-256 no longer matches (`test_jira_dc_harness_shape.py`, `test_bridge_provider_wrappers.py`, `test_reconcile_workflow_lint.py`). Text-mode writes and stdin add `\r`: the plan-replay `objects/info/alternates` path reads back as `objects?` (`test_plan_replay_tier2.py`), `run_git` text stdin hashes differently (`test_run_git_wrapper.py::test_str_input_is_forwarded_to_stdin`), and `sha256sum` sees `'mcp-publisher.tar.gz'$'\r'` (`test_mcp_publisher_pin.py`). On macOS, `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL` with `core.autocrlf=true` reproduces `test_dc_store_copy_bounded_25e0.py` and `test_reclaim_bridge_history.py`.

Evidence: Windows runs on throwaway branch `tmp/w05-remeasure` with origin/main `717c50f8b33` code plus a selection-only workflow change: run 44665461131 (the 242 `unclassified.args` entries; 48 passed, 194 failed or errored) and run 44681457334 (the 194, xdist, JUnit XML with full tracebacks). Both 2026-11-19 PST.

Modules:
- `tests/integration/test_reclaim_bridge_history.py` (1)
- `tests/unit/evals/test_plan_replay_tier2.py` (4)
- `tests/unit/reconciler/test_jira_dc_harness_shape.py` (1)
- `tests/unit/test_dc_store_copy_bounded_25e0.py` (1)
- `tests/unit/test_mcp_publisher_pin.py` (1)
- `tests/unit/test_run_git_wrapper.py` (1)
- `tests/unit/workflow/test_bridge_provider_wrappers.py` (1)
- `tests/unit/workflow/test_reconcile_workflow_lint.py` (1)

## Approach
Pin the vendored and hashed files `eol=lf` in `.gitattributes`, write LF explicitly where a file or stdin feeds git or a checksum, and decide whether rebar's own git calls pin `core.autocrlf=false` for the tickets store. Remove each line from `crlf.args` as it passes.

## Scope
Test or product code for the listed modules, plus `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/crlf.args` (remove each fixed line; delete the file and its `@` reference in `.github/workflows/test.yml` once empty).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every line removed from `crlf.args` names a test that passed in a `sweep (windows)` run on main after the fix (run id recorded in a comment).
- [ ] `crlf.args` is empty and deleted with its reference in `.github/workflows/test.yml`, or each remaining line names a test recorded on this ticket as intentionally unsupported on Windows with the reason.
data.title: Windows sweep: 11 tests fail on CRLF from core.autocrlf=true or text-mode newline translation
